text: As I stand here, surrounded by striking colors and bold text advocating "R+D"—research and development—I feel curious and invigorated. The anticipation of new ideas and the intellectual energy in this space awaken my own sense of wonder. I feel like a participant in a larger narrative of innovation, and I am reminded of how environments can inspire thought and creativity. There is a subtle tension too, between the sterile safety of the fire extinguisher outside and the vibrant, experimental world within. I feel alert, attentive, and oddly hopeful.
